name: Vyasa
desc:
Vyasa is canceled, y u guys still playing [insert crying emoji]

Vyasa is an RPG game made with droplets rpg kit and heavily modified by Veennoid, with the help of YoiYai for doing the maps.

In Vyasa, you will use your Weapons, Abilities, and Passives to defeat Enemies to get rewards, and continue to sail to different islands.

Vyasa's world is made of many different islands.  Your mission is to conquer those islands and become the strongest captain there is!

[This is our first project]
